Before you install

  • This fork is signed with its own key, so Android will not install it over the upstream Wisp build (same app ID, com.wisp.app — you get INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE). To switch: back up your recovery phrase / nsec first, uninstall upstream Wisp (this wipes local keys and wallet data), then install this APK.
  • Verify the APK checksum against SHA256SUMS, or check the signing certificate fingerprint above in your installer.
  • This is an independent fork build. It is not published or endorsed by the upstream author.

What changed in this fork

  • DM seal authentication and rumor-author binding (NIP-17)
  • Fail-closed BIP-39 mnemonic validation with Unicode-space normalization
  • All previously merged security hardening: LNURL zap-request binding, receipt consistency checks, SSRF guards, bech32 checksum verification
  • LNURL responses on chunked/HTTP-2 transports read correctly (zaps to Cloudflare-fronted providers were broken)
  • DM media auto-fetch gated behind a setting — no zero-click IP leak; size caps and SHA-256 verification on media
  • Crash logs redact secrets before writing
